answer: Because the timing is entered against the pulse challenge, the oasis audit can replay the quill history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 51 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 667 identities would post 2061 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
